meta.occupancyRule: A room is occupied on a date when checkIn <= date < checkOut. If check-in or check-out is null, those nights are not marked occupied.
meta.amountRule: null means pending. statedAmount is the figure given for the whole stay. Do not copy it into gross, fees, or net unless that split is known. Do not invent amounts, party sizes, or dates.
meta.privacy: This repo is public. Store a first name and last initial only. Never store door codes, Wi-Fi passwords, card numbers, phone numbers, emails, reservation numbers, or payout batch ids.
meta.updater: Hourly refresh: commit only rental/data.json. Set meta.lastChecked. Leave unknown money and dates as null.

revenueSummary.basis: Night-stayed: each stay amount spread evenly over its nights (Today/Yesterday: by check-in day, full stay amount). Gross = Booking.com Total payment; Airbnb Gross earnings (guest price before host fee); Agoda gross unknown. Net = Booking.com Total payment minus Commission; Airbnb host payout (Amount); Agoda payout. Only OK/confirmed stays; cancelled and no-show excluded (none had a fee charged). Occupancy = nights / (3 rooms x days). ADR = gross / nights with known gross.
